scope: Local Word conversion quality checks; not arbitrary mathematical semantic equivalence

private_local_paper.renderer: Installed Microsoft Word read-only PDF export followed by Poppler page rendering
known_limits: Continuous mode changes pagination and equation/figure positions
Formula-heavy lines and paragraphs may remain complete images
Running headers, footers and captions can need manual cleanup
Simple OMML inference must be reviewed; it does not recover original LaTeX

reproducible_fixtures: matrix-scaled text, generated spaces, hidden/covered text and Unicode
staggered and aligned columns, full-width prose, scanned and rotated pages
Greek variables, sub/superscripts, numerator and denominator semantics
unsupported large operator with equation number retained as one image
figure labels retained with complete artwork
Computer Modern Roman body classification and reading order
